serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Total Visibility Anywhere (TVA) is a cloud-based Software as a Service (SaaS) that is hosted within the East/West Regions of Amazon Web Services (AWS). TVA provides an integrated view across all functions within the supply chain by improving performance and data quality, providing a unified workflow and real-time global asset tracking and productive insights with comprehensive, multi-function visibility. TVA provides in-depth Asset, Fleet, Shipment, Order, Warehouse, Request, and Device and Sensor management capabilities.
